acceptanceCriteria: A symlinked .context-corvint parent causes reset and load to refuse; the outside slot-weights.json remains byte-identical.
Directory substitution between validation and removal cannot redirect reset outside the pinned repository.
Absent-state reset still succeeds; ordinary admitted-file reset restores default context behavior.
body:
Comprehensive expert audit 2026-09-26, SEC-01. Audited source 2961076fc0b78bfab743578f2ef5c17006be058a. Evidence classification: confirmed.

If .context-corvint is a symlink to an accessible external directory containing slot-weights.json, Reset joins the repository path, Lstats only the final component, and removes through the symlinked parent. The explicit reset can therefore delete another directory’s file. LoadAdmittedSlotWeights likewise reads an external regular file through that parent. This is a source-confirmed missing containment check; no exploit fixture or public-CLI demonstration was executed.

Source: internal/slotlearn/slotlearn.go:215; internal/contextindex/slot_weights.go:113; cmd/corvint/eval_slot_weights.go:46

Owning contract/status: ["LTA-V0-011", "LTA-V0-012", "AGENTS.md invariant 5"]

Verification: {"method": "Source inspection and existing regression tests only", "test": "TestLTAV0012AdmittedTraceRoundTripsAndResetRestoresDefault passes; only absent/ordinary local-file cases, no parent symlink case. Package suite passed.", "reproduction": "NOT_RUN: coordinator explicitly prohibited payloads and exploit fixtures."}

Suggested correction: Resolve and pin the admitted repository root; reject symlinked store components and use descriptor-relative contained operations for load/reset. Preserve the intended ability to remove an invalid leaf symlink without following its target.

Report: .agent-evidence/2026-09-26-comprehensive-audit.md; retained expert and reproduction evidence in .agent-evidence/audit-20260926/. Run focused regressions and owning documentation checks; exhaustive gate only when governing release policy requires it. No implementation, intent acceptance or promotion is claimed.
title: Slot-weight reset follows a symlinked parent outside the repository
